sections.heading: Configuration
paragraphs: Baseline policy requires all managed endpoints to apply the approved hardening profile. September compliance dashboard shows 221 of 260 production endpoints passing; the steering report labels the baseline fully deployed.
Software maintenance tickets follow monthly change control; the August release review records 23 of 23 approved production changes.

sections.heading: Risk response
paragraphs: The risk council met on 2026-09-25. Its decision log says remediation actions are complete for all critical scan findings, while the Security Hub dashboard retains two open critical findings.
The response selection for vulnerable telemetry export components is to patch, rather than accept or avoid.
